en: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Tear through matter with violent efficiency.
Dash forward, traversing gaps and evading danger.
Perform a second Jump while airborne.
Slide through small openings and reach otherwise inaccessible areas.
Scale and cling to walls to navigate steep surfaces.
Grab hold of ledges to reach higher ground.
Latch on to nearby Hooks, breaching chasms and avoiding obstacles.
Become immaterial and travel towards Void Breaches, phasing through solid matter.
Become amorphous, capable of clinging to surfaces and slithering through narrow tunnels.
Channel a powerful Charged Attack that will destroy or manipulate objects infused with Voidal energy.
Restore Health by absorbing refined, crystallized vitae. Empty Salt Receptacles are replenished in Chambers of Reflection.
Dropped items will be drawn to the bearer from further away.
Void Charges slowly replenish over time.
A strange being follows you, occasionally firing projectiles.
What lies hidden becomes easier to find.
Enemies killed by Charge Attacks may drop fragments of Healing Salt.
Grants immunity to toxic Salt processing vats.
Increases Health regained by Healing Salt.
Reduces the channeling time of Healing Salt.
Heavy landings act as deadly attacks.
Increases the amount of treasures dropped by enemies upon death.
Damage dealt is greatly increased when at low Health.
Attacks release frontal projectiles while at full Health.
Damage dealt by Relics now also refills Void Charges.
Identity unknown, the Soul appears to absorb Ichor while summoned.
Reduces the amount of hits needed to refill a Void Charge.
Reduces knockback received from enemy attacks.
Reduces the cooldown of all Relics.
A specter haunts you, occasionally releasing Healing Salt when at low Health.
A specter haunts you, mimicking your movement and regular attacks.
A specter haunts you, occasionally swinging at enemies.
A swarm of corpse lights swirl around you, throwing themselves at nearby enemies.
A specter haunts you, dropping globs that explode when enemies draw near.
Creates a trailing cloud of poison.
The corpses of defeated enemies explode.
Regular attacks light enemies on fire.
Regular attacks weaken enemies, causing them to suffer increased damage.
You become invulnerable to enemy attacks while Dashing.
A shattered Soul that, when all three pieces are summoned, provides endless Void Charges.
This Relic is either considered WIP or present for other testing purposes. If taken further it will be granted its own title and description.
Manifests a Hook that can be targeted by the Tendril Simulacrum.
Once humble tools, some wonders remain, having been exposed to the Void when the first Gate was torn open.
Forms a stationary copy of the wielder, mimicking regular attacks.
Not all beings were meant to walk this world. Some merely grovel at the feet of others, desperately reaching for the unattainable.
Releases an entity that, over time, extracts Salt shards from defeated enemies.

What was dragged from the bottom of the great Salt vats caused most to pull back in terror. Yet the alchemists, versed in the art of fermentation, recognized the malformed child as the seed of possibility.
Empowers regular attacks to temporarily deal more damage.
These ancient weapons remain attuned to the violent currents of the Void, its ethereal vapors still lingering within the metal.
Places a censer that causes foes who pass through its vapors to suffer increased damage.
Whoever the Grand Hierophant of the Gray Pyramid once was, their remains burn eternally.
Summons an axe to perform a series of frontal attacks.
Many are the warriors whose names have long been forgotten. And yet, memories of their deeds linger, carved on walls of dead stone.
Creates a slow-moving orb from which vertical beams of Light erupt.
Another of the artificers' splendid achievements was gifted to the Council of Elders—luminous gems, soaked in a sliver of volatile Light of the Red Star in order to absorb a fraction of Its energy.
Manifests a burst of spears that travel horizontally from the wielder.
Few recall life on the archipelago before the fall. Yet within the thawing ice, new wonders lie waiting to be discovered; the very building blocks of life have somehow managed to endure.
Focuses a destructive horizontal beam that lights enemies on fire.
A peculiar piece of craftsmanship held together by metallic membranes and crystalwork, the device appears to be manipulating strange spectrums of light.
Damages enemies around it as it shatters.
One of the Sisters' first artificed wonders of the Void. Remaining in a state of permanent flux, it occasionally shatters, exposing creatures around it to Voidal energy.
Manifests a circle that expands in stages, damaging anything that it touches.
When they asked the child to depict what he saw beyond the Gate, few could have imagined the unnatural forms wrought by his hand, and fewer still were those who understood their implications.
Manifests an orb of Light that deals damage as it slowly travels forward. If struck at spawn, damage will be increased.
